root_directory.description: The root directory path to check. Uses @ for recursive and # for single-level wildcards.

hostname.description: Hostname to treat local HTTP links as local files.

http_port.description: Port to use for HTTP site checking when combined with hostname.

use_http.description: If true, checks files via HTTP protocol instead of local filesystem.

http_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for HTTP requests.

request_delay.description: Delay in seconds between requests to the same host.

doc_directory.description: Path to the output directory for documentation. If empty, no doc directory is created.

output_file.description: Path to the single output file for errors/warnings.

file_limit.description: Limit the number of HTML files checked.

ignore_patterns.description: List of patterns to ignore files matching them. Uses @ and # wildcards.

skip_patterns.description: List of patterns to skip files matching them. Files exist but links are not checked.

case_sensitive.description: If true, ensures filename case in links matches filesystem case.

check_orphans.description: If true, checks for unused (orphan) files in directories.

substitution_maps.description: List of substitution maps for server-side image maps or redirects. Format: '/a=/b'.

http_headers.description: List of HTTP headers to add. Format: 'Name: Value'.

proxy_server.description: Proxy server hostname[:port] for remote HTTP requests.

auth_credentials.description: Authentication credentials for protected realms. Format: 'realm user:password'.

quiet_mode.description: If true, disables printing progress to the screen.

silent_mode.description: If true, disables printing summarys to the screen.

check_remote_links.description: If true, checks all remote links after doing a site check.

use_status_cache.description: If true, uses status cache for remote checking (-netmod/-netset).

cache_flush.description: If true, removes all URLs from the cache not currently being checked.

cache_directory.description: Directory to read/write the linklint.url cache file.

ignore_anchors.description: If true, tells Linklint to ignore named anchors.

ignore_query_strings.description: If true, removes query strings before making HTTP requests.

follow_redirects.description: If true, checks for <meta> redirects in remote URLs.

concise_remote_output.description: If true, turns off printing successful URLs to STDOUT during remote link checking.

output_index_name.description: Name for the output index files (index.txt/index.html).

doc_base_url.description: Base expression for directing a browser to resources in HTML output files.

html_frames.description: If true, HTML data files are opened in a new frame.

text_only.description: If true, prevents any HTML files from being created in the doc directory.

html_only.description: If true, erases redundant text files in the doc directory after HTML creation.

suppress_output_files.description: List of patterns for files not to create (-dont_output).

index_file.description: Default index file name to use instead of the default list.

url_doc_prefix.description: Prefix for remote URL output files.

retry_failed_hosts.description: If true, only checks URLs that have a host fail status in the cache.

use_checksum.description: If true, ensures every modified URL is reported via checksum.

add_xrefs.description: If true, adds cross references to the lists.

sort_by_referrer.description: If true, sorts lists by referring file.

list_files.description: If true, lists all found files, links, directories.

list_errors.description: If true, lists missing files and other errors.
